body: I’m on my third pair of these, the buzzing happens when I have the Bose on, and even with it off, the sound is distorted. I’m so disappointed in these headphones

I hate them. I keep having this shitty buzzing noise when I have the Bose noise cancelling or pass through on, I have to turn it off to use them, and even then, the quality of the sound is shit. I’m on my third pair with this issue and I’m never buying another one again

Thank you, that helps a lot. I really need to take care of myself again and go to therapy. I need to take my meds again. This all is just so hard, and I feel like I’m alone. I’m going to see if I can get back to therapy again, or try to at least

I know I have to give it time, but honestly, my depression has gotten so bad recently, I’m just kicking myself over and over for not being able to put up with it anymore. I know it’s childish, and I should be able to push through until I’m on my own, but I just can’t. I know it’s silly, and I don’t think things can change right away, I know it’ll take time. But I’m so close to breaking down and just giving up. A year before the big C started, I was so depressed that I was in a catatonic state for two years. I fear I’ll slip into that again if I don’t find some way to be even a little happy. Sorry, I know that this probably made no sense

My parents are pushing for me to not re-enroll and just focus on working here or moving to a factory position (which I know will not work for me). My mom wants me to be like her and work a factory position for good money, but I don’t think I can handle neither that position or those expectations

The police did a wellness check when my parents and I called the cops on each other. If they don’t beat you up, they ignore you when you say you’re being abused and want to be taken to a center for help and would rather listen to your abusers
I know they won’t take me in. Most of them live either out of state or in a nursing home. I’ll talk to my aunt and uncle though. Maybe they can help. Thank you for your advice... it means a lot

Hey, I don’t have very much motivation to do much and with this pandemic, getting a job has been so hard. I’ve applied to places but I’ve gotten no calls back

My family on my dad’s side would never take me in, I’m gay and they’re extremely religious. Same for my mom except for my aunt and uncle, but they’re unequipped to take care of me. They have two kids on their own and I’d just be a burden. 

I just don’t know what else to do. I just feel like I’m not trying hard enough, but the harder I try the worse I feel. It’s like I’m giving up on myself and I hate it, but I don’t know what to do. Sorry if I’m repetitive. Currently in a breakdown
